items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: How often did you take a lesson from Louis Cantrell? Twice a week... He used to tell me to practice two hours every day.

ctx.x: Now, did you get drum parts to play with that?

Oh yeah, yeah, yeah. Well, you see it's different with orchestra than with the little bands that you're affiliated with. Because this is the reason why I say I can play all the folks with any kind of type of drumming because I play with them all. I play with fellas that couldn't read and I play with fellas that were musicians. And I play with the best of musicians that you have that's gone and some that's here today. I was going to ask a little bit more about your lessons in the beginning. How often did you take…
Yeah. How long did you go to him for lessons about that? Two years. Two years. And how long was it before he let you play with the regular drum? Not just the drum?
